items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tommy Potter on bass, Eric Kluger on drums. There was Joe Roland on vibes, Tal Fallow on guitar, and I played on piano.

ctx.x: When you were with Shaw who was in the band?
Tommy Potter on base. It was a small group, I did not play with his big band. Tommy Potter on bass, Eric Kluger on drums. There was Joe Roland on vibes, Tal Fallow on guitar, and I played on piano.
That’s sort of the band that straddles swing and bebop.
